ADDED i1: Tests for {@link DayOfYear}.

Under EvoSuite the system clock is mocked to a fixed instant, so {@link DayOfYear#now()} deterministically resolves to the 45th
ADDED i2: {@link DayOfYear#now()} reads the (mocked) system clock and {@link DayOfYear#getValue()} returns the matching day-of-year value.
